description: This file defines platform abstraction types and a default 'empty' platform implementation for the Playwright project, including platform-specific utilities, environment, and stream handling.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: A context for managing execution zones with push, pop, run, and data methods.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: An interface describing platform-specific functionalities such as environment, file system, and stream handling.

methods.name: noopZone
methods.description: A no-operation implementation of the Zone interface.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Asynchronous method to calculate SHA1 hash of a string, not implemented in 'empty' platform.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Method to create a GUID, not implemented in 'empty' platform.

methods.name: streamFile
methods.description: Streams a file to a writable stream, not available in 'empty' platform.
